title: REQ · Factory selects the agent from the configured provider kind
summary: provider.New maps mock and claude to agents and rejects other kinds
description: Context: config.Worker.ProviderKind holds mock or claude. Desired behavior: provider.New(kind, exec) returns the Mock for mock, the Claude adapter for claude and an error for any other value. Expected result: the runner can be built from config. Why: selection must be driven by config.
acceptance_criteria: Given kind mock, When New is called, Then the result is a Mock
Given kind claude and a fake Exec, When New is called, Then the result is a Claude
Given kind gpt, When New is called, Then the error text contains gpt
Given kind claude and a nil Exec, When New is called, Then it returns an error

out_of_scope: editing cmd wiring, which does not exist yet

technical_constraints: Kind strings match config: mock and claude
